messages:
alex: afternoon check-in — landed prefetch refactor on feature branch (prefetch v2). microbench looks promising.
mika: nice. can you paste the exact bench command you used?
alex: sure: ```./scripts/bench.sh --model=gptx --seq=512 --batch=4 --iters=250 --cache=kv --prefetch=auto``` got p95 ~118ms (was ~128 before)
tara: quick Q: did you change kv eviction thresholds in that branch? i saw higher miss rate on last canary run
alex: no eviction logic changes, only prefetch path + smaller prefetch window; misses might be from race when prefetch overlaps eviction
nora: blocking for canary: infra needs to expose runtime flag `--max-prefetch=128` in dedicated canary pools. who owns infra rollout?
zane: I can take infra rollout, but need INF ticket + test plan
alex: created ticket INF-789 with test steps and safety timeouts: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-789
ci-bot: deploy pipeline kicked: alex/prefetch-v2 #452 -> staging
mika: also saw a logging spamline in the prefetch hotpath, add a conditional debug log pls
alex: good catch, will drop to trace for the hotpath
drew: FYI, ran end-to-end perf harness on multi-gpu; observed +11% kv miss at seq=1024 with batch=8 on canary sim.
tara: that's concerning. can we reproduce on local with env override? (no infra change)
drew: env override helps for single-gpu, not for shard boundary issues. need infra flag for realistic repro
nora: zane assigned INF-789 to infra oncall, ETA for flag rollout ~tomorrow morning UTC
alex: tiny ask: can someone review #452? pinging @drew @mika @tara
mika: reviewing now, will leave a couple nits about naming and tests
drew: I'll review after lunch. main thing: remove one expensive memcpy in prefetch codepath
tara: agree to merge after nits + one more perf run. ensure rolling window metrics stay enabled for 24h after canary
ci-bot: perf run finished (pr-452/2026-03-17): p50 ~unchanged, p95 -7%, cost/token -3%. run id: pr-452-2026-03-17
alex: great, plan for today: address review nits, add trace log, run full perf harness at 21:00 UTC, coordinate canary with infra tomorrow
mika: I'll schedule the harness and tag team when it's kicked off
zane: infra will try to apply flag to the staging pool in the morning; will post update in INF-789
nora: thanks. blockers resolved for now, only dependency is infra rollout
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: (reacted with :eyes:)
